notes.title: Myst developer Kickstarting new steampunk VR puzzle adventure Firmament
notes.content:
Cyan Worlds, the developer behind seminal puzzle adventure Myst, has launched a Kickstarter to fund development of its new VR game Firmament.

Those with decently honed memory skills might recall that Firmament was initially unveiled in March last year, whereupon it was referred to as a "new steampunk adventure". That early reveal was accompanied by a surprisingly lengthy "teaser" trailer, suggesting that development was reasonably well underway.

Twelve months on, and Firmament has re-emerged on Kickstarter for a bout of crowdfunding, with an estimated release of July 2020 - assuming it meets its goal. And while there's not a huge amount of new information to be gleaned beyond what was teased last year, Cyan has clarified a few points and shared some snippets of new gameplay footage to woo potential backers.

Read more

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 - Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Just another round of improvements:

[list]
[*] Computer cannon statistics now register correctly on the game's final stat screen.
[*] The final stat screen now properly displays the computer's difficulty.
[*] The game's targeting system will no longer attempt to automatically target a valid tile, but will instead display an error message. This was originally implemented to help the player, but it proved to be too disorienting.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - More bug fixes
notes.content:
• The AI now uses cannons as intended.
• Fixed the "cannot join the game" bug.
• Fixed a bug that caused an unintended "not adjacent" error message that had extra information in it.
• Fixed a bug that caused your government selection to not save properly.
• Game names can now have a space in them.
• The Lithuanian flag now displays properly on the leaderboard.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Enhancements and Fixes
notes.content:
• Blank or "Unknown" flags for CPU and human players are now shown as dark blue solid flags.
• When adding CPU opponents, it will now default to the difficulty you last selected.
• Fixed a bug that caused the CPU opponents to erroneously disconnect in some cases.
• Your computer will now remember your preferred screen size on launch.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - More Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Cleaned up a few more minor bugs after streaming last night:

• You can now re-fortify tiles that have been nuked.
• AI players have received a bump in their calculated resource values. This will help them appear more aligned with human players.
• Fixed a tile in central China that was not properly linked to its neighbor.
• AI players will now use their cannons attacks as intended.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Minor bug fix:

• Fixed diplomacy flag images for AI players when it is manually selected in the game lobby.

notes.title: Patch 1.0 is live!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0 is here! Here are the final bug fixes and enhancements for the full release version:

• Fixed a bug that caused CPU player state in the game lobby to get out of sync in some circumstances.
• Fixed the displayed status of online players on your friend list.
• Fixed the instant update of player flags when updated on the title chat room.
• You can now add yourself to your friends list. Hey, why not?
• When a player leaves a full game in the game lobby, it now reappears to players looking for an open game.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 Is Finally Here!
notes.content:
The mega update is finally here! Firmament Wars has been upgraded with a highly optimized caching system to store game data. Expect gameplay to feel much smoother and faster than ever! Along with the redesign are some updates as well:

• Literally everything should feel faster and the game should scale better in terms of supporting more concurrent players. This is where the bulk of the work went in this patch! A big deal if you decided to tell all of your friends about how cool Firmament Wars is...
• Friends lists are now stored locally on your computer. Your old friend list is gone. Sorry! It was for the best. Trust me.
• Fixed a bug in team games with AI opponents that sometimes caused games to end prematurely.
• Removed the GET troop bonuses from the game for reasons.

notes.title: Upgrading to version 0.3 - Outage Taking Longer Than Expected
notes.content: Apologies for the extended outage. We'll be right back when everything is working as expected! The latest update came with some unexpected behavior.

notes.title: Full Release Pushed to Late August to Finish Netcode Optimization
notes.content:
Thanks to all of the helpful feedback from players, we found several important improvements to work on! For the time being, we are finished adding maps. Since the start of Early Access on June 23rd, we have added five new maps and improved one map. We hoped to release today, however the netcode optimizations are taking longer than expected, so we will mark Firmament Wars as "full release" as soon as those changes are completed. We hope that is no later than the end of August. 

The lobby and title screen have already been full refactored, but we are still finishing up refactoring the netcode for the game mode itself. Our goal is that the game will be able to support hundreds, perhaps thousands, of concurrent players once the changes are finished.

notes.title: New 8-Player Flat Earth Map And More!
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.6 has added the following:

• A new 8-player Flat Earth map has been added to the game.
• The map now zooms out farther than before to allow players to see more at once.
• Made various server-side performance optimizations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32657783/2783ae247cdde26beb37021b71ee5f7ef508c17a.png[/img]

notes.title: New 6-player Map: China!
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.5 has changed the following:

• A new 6-player map in China! They say never fight a land war in Asia, but we'll make an exception for this 126-tile behemoth!
• Adjustments and optimizations to several maps and the mouse zoom feature. Continuous optimizations are still on-going in response to feedback from a variety of players. We want to get it perfectly smooth for full release on August 8th!
• Fixes to weapon targeting in some circumstances. I have decided to allow you to launch weapons at tiles with 1 unit so that the game feels more responsive and so players may anticipate a deployment with a missile.
• Reduced the cooldown of Attack and Split Attack to half a second down from 1 second.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32657783/ff7a1bab2fc136f62bcd8947fdd806eade81bcb6.png[/img]

notes.title: New Leaderboards!
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.4 Introduced the following updates:

• There is a new national power ranking leaderboard that lists players' actual nations by wins.
• There is a new flag power ranking leaderboard that lists all player-selected flags by wins.
• The game will now prevent you from firing cannons, missiles, and nukes at tiles with only 1 unit.
• Fixed the scrollbars that were messed up by the previous patch.
• Resized the Japanese map. The entire map was scaled to be much larger, so it should be much easier to click the tiles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32657783/56c747d2ebb8ed552be130c15aaa0d07e7eca3d8.png[/img]

notes.title: Free New Map: Europe Mena!
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.3 notes:
• New 8-player map called Europe Mena (Middle-East, North Africa). This huge 137-tile map is perfect for battling groups of friends around the Mediterranean Sea!
• Updated the game engine to run more recent versions of everything for better performance and feature support.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32657783/bfa06a975f35ffc194cc2c5533fe9b0d1ac6cb67.png[/img]

notes.title: New Alpha Earth map! And 90+ new flags!
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.2 notes:

• New 8-player Alpha Earth map! A giant world map for your global warfare needs! This is also the new default map.
• Added about 90 new flags. I lost count. I added every flag for existing nations that were missing.
• You can now zoom OUT on the map to get a wider glimpse of the map.
• You can now drag and flick the map. Because that's neat.
• The old Earth Omega map is now a 6-player map.
• The Earth Omega map now includes a bridge from Sweden to Germany. Hurray for bridges!
• Japan's maximum players was changed from 3 to 2.
• Turkey's maximum players was changed from 7 to 4.
• United Kingdom's maximum players was changed from 8 to 6.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32657783/cd545a91b92ec52eada0ad5de0e808f80342e5c2.png[/img]

notes.title: Free New Germany Map! Over 50 New Flags!
notes.content:
Patch 0.2.1:

• There is a new 8-player map: Germany! Duke it out on the biggest map ever!
• There are now over 50 new flags in the game!
• Flags now support transparency where appropriate such as Nepal and Ohio.
• You can now select the flag of CPU players
• The AI has been adjusted and re-balanced to reduce network bottlenecks and apparently client-size freezing when playing many AI opponents.
• All maps now have more comfortable padding around them so that the UI doesn't obstruct the maps.
• An improvement was made to the net code that starts multiplayer games. Games will now start more reliably with all player data loading correctly by all players.
• Communism's "Deploy Anywhere" perk has been fixed.
• Games should start up noticeably faster due to loading map assets directly from the client.
• The spectator mode works much better now! The options menu will still work and you can reset when the game is done.
• A Reset Game button has been added to the options.
• The leaderboard is a little bit wider now to accommodate all of that juicy data.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32657783/f9d429387247971c6c38ac546434b5404c6cfdb3.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Begins!
notes.content: Patch 0.2.0 is now available and early access has begun! Expect continued development, bug fixes, and new maps up until the scheduled release date: August 8th, 2018!

notes.title: Update 0.1.7 released!
notes.content:
• Attack and Split Attack now have a 1-second cooldown.
• Six new languages are now supported: French, Korean, Japanese, Turkish, Polish, and Italian.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.6 Updates
notes.content: • Localization support added for simplified Chinese, Russian, German, and Portuguese!

notes.title: New release date: 8/8/18 at 8 a.m. PDT
notes.content: I have decided to push the release date to August 8th, 2018, at 0800 PDT in order to finish its localization into multiple languages. I plan to support at least 8 more languages and 8 more maps to the game at launch. Both of these changes will help broaden the appeal of the game to a wider audience.

notes.title: Localization In Progress
notes.content: We are currently working on translating Firmament Wars into multiple languages! Expect support for popular languages at launch!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.5 Updates
notes.content:
• Optimized the water animation which should considerably improve performance on older systems
• Fixed a bug that caused weapon cooldowns to activate when targeting an invalid target.
• Fixed a bug that allowed you to try targeting with weapons you haven't unlocked in the tech tree yet.
• Democracy new gains 3 instead of 2 available troops when they lose a tile.
• Fascism no longer benefits from science bonuses from barbarian huts.
• Fascism now has +1 attack from tiles for each defensive structure.
• Moved one of the possible starting points on the France map for a more balanced starting position.
• Disabled HTTP throttling that was causing some unintentional various bugs, including not ending the game properly in some circumstances.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4 Updates
notes.content:
• Flag select menu now shows inline preview flags.
• Fixed a bug that caused a client-side state of a tile to be incorrect after eliminating a player.
• Improved filtering of all steam names and text inputs.
• Democracy now gains 2 reserve troops when they lose a tile instead of gaining +3 on the map randomly.
• You can now toggle the visibility of the flag panel in game.

notes.title: Update 0.1.2 released!
notes.content:
Cleaned up some bug fixes:
- Fixes to team mode 
- Fixes to weapon timers.
- Fixes to displayed costs for weapons under Communism.

notes.title: Pre-release updates 6/12
notes.content:
New updates include:
- Fixed a bug that prevented games from detecting when it's over in some circumstances.
- All weapons, cannons, missiles, and nukes, now have a cooldown of 2, 5, and 30 seconds, respectively.
- Fixed a bug that caused an off-by-one unit math error when moving into unexplored territory.

notes.title: Firmament Wars - First Build Approved
notes.content:
That was the final "hurdle" before being able to publish the game on July 6th. I have also requested keys for people that have been waiting to try it out. I will be distributing them mainly via the Neverworks Games Discord group.
